description.value: The Little Campbell River Hatchery is a fish hatchery operated by the Semiahmoo Fish & Game Club, a community-based conservation organization in Surrey, BC. Located along the Little Campbell River, it supports salmon and steelhead enhancement programs in the watershed. Cyclists exploring the rural farmland and greenways of south Surrey may find it a worthwhile stop as a working conservation attraction.
